requirements.title: No direct PHP superglobal references in inspected application files

remediation: Investigate and change: Open each reported file and line and trace the superglobal value to its use. In Magento HTTP controllers/services use an injected Magento\Framework\App\RequestInterface to obtain request parameters or headers where appropriate; then apply explicit type, length and allow-list validation. Replacing $_GET with getParam alone does not validate input.

Validate the change: For $_FILES use the supported upload abstraction and verify file type/storage policy; for $_SERVER distinguish trusted server metadata from client-controlled headers. Test missing, malformed and unauthorized input plus the relevant SQL/HTML/path/network sink. Document a narrow justified exception for non-HTTP bootstrap/server metadata rather than blindly replacing every reference.
